sessions.phase_label: Representative chapter review and engagement scoping
Final visual strategy pass for Chapters 7–10

requirements.title: Chapter Visual Strategy Recommendations
requirements.definition: Provide chapter-level visual strategy decisions and high-level reasoning covering which visuals to keep, cut, move, add, source, obtain permission for, or create later.
requirements.boundary_note: Selection, placement, permission, sourcing, creation recommendations, and their high-level rationale are tightly coupled dimensions of one advisory mechanism. Final design, formatting, image sourcing, and graphic creation are excluded rather than treated as separate deliverables.

requirements.title: Manuscript Visual Placeholders
requirements.definition: Insert visual placeholders into the supplied manuscript chapters as an independently deliverable representation of planned visual placement.

requirements.title: Chapter Image Tracker Updates
requirements.definition: Update the supplied image tracker for each chapter set to reflect the visual plan.

unresolved_candidates.description: The sample review mentions caption guidance, but the client does not clearly include caption recommendations among the subsequent contracted deliverables.

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text:
Hi Gina, I've reviewed Chapter 6 alongside your image tracker and put together my recommendations in the attached doc. It covers what to reposition, what to remove or replace (including a licensing flag worth knowing about). Where new visuals would add the most authority, and a note on captions.
Happy to walk through any of it or jump straight into the full manuscript if you'd like to move forward.

execution.observed_behavior: Freelancer reports completing Chapter 6 visual-strategy recommendations covering repositioning, removal or replacement, licensing, new visual opportunities, and captions.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hi Innocent,

I’d like to move forward with the visual strategy pass at $600 total, but I’d like to break it into three $200 milestones so we can keep the process clean.

For each milestone, I’ll send the chapter files, image tracker, and any available visuals.

Deliverables for each milestone:

1\. Manuscript chapters with visual placeholders inserted
2\. Updated image tracker for those chapters
3\. High-level explanation of the visual placement strategy for each chapter, so I understand the reasoning behind what should be kept, cut, moved, added, sourced, or created

The goal is to decide:

what visuals belong
what should be cut
where visuals should go
what needs to be sourced
what needs permission
what should be created later

This is visual strategy and placement only — not final design, formatting, image sourcing, or graphic creation.

Milestone 1 — $200
Chapters 1–3

Milestone 2 — $200
Chapters 4–6

Milestone 3 — $200
Chapters 7–10

Please confirm if this structure works for you.

Thanks,
Gina

value_updates.strategy_output: High-level explanation of the visual placement strategy for each chapter

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hi Innocent,

I’m sending over the final chapter set for the last round, along with the updated image tracker.

I don’t have additional photo assets to provide for this round, so please focus on the manuscript, image placeholders, and tracker. Where a visual is still needed, please note the type of image or graphic that would work best and any recommendations for strengthening the visual plan.

The goal for this round is to make sure the remaining chapters have a clear, usable image strategy before the manuscript moves into the next production phase.

Thank you!
Gina
